title: Chapter 1320
text:
At the same time, in the Dawn Star Cluster, the Flickering World portal.

The surface of the many military base planets was filled with many deep wells, in which were hidden many Beyond Grade A Psionic Planet Annihilation Cannons. They were aimed at the Garu Star Cluster, the Crown Star Cluster, and the Renault Star Cluster. These were the areas of the second exploration phase and were now the prosperous territories of many Beyond Grade A organizations. Among them, most of the Planet Annihilation Cannons were aimed at Black Star's territory.

The Dawn Star Cluster was the area that the Red Empire had taken over the earliest. Many of the planets were military restricted areas. After decades of secret modification, the insides of these planets had long been modified into special anti-star weapons.

After the first Meeting of the Gods a few decades ago, the Red Empire had secretly carried out this modification project to prepare for the current situation. Once the situation changed, this Star Cluster could immediately become a bridgehead for war and seal off the normal channels between the Flickering World and the explored universe.

The fleets of the three Universal Civilizations were stationed all over the Dawn Star Cluster, and the temporary command center of the three Universal Civilizations was changed from Planet Lighthouse to a military planet in the Dawn Star Cluster.

"Maintain the highest alert level for the next ten days. As long as the joint fleet starts a war in the Mechanical Race's territory, it will be the signal for us to take action. Bombard all the Beyond Grade A organizations, including the Black Star Corps' territory."

In the temporary command center, Ewen Fabic looked around at the many officers in the room with eyes as sharp as an eagle's.

He was a high-ranking officer of the Red Empire. After Tarrokov retired, he took over as the marshal of the dynasty's exploration army. In the recent storm, the three Universal Civilizations had divided the Flickering World into an independent and important war zone, and he directly became the commander of the war zone, in charge of commanding the military operations of the three Universal Civilizations in the Flickering World.

"Understood," everyone replied in unison.

Ewen turned to look at one of the officers and said, "The higher-ups don't have enough manpower, so they can't send their direct Beyond Grade As to guard this place. How are the interception measures? When the battle starts, the Beyond Grade As will definitely try to take down the command center with their individual strength. If we can't stop them from invading the Dawn Star Cluster, the situation will be very passive. "

"The engineering team is racing against time to set up the interception equipment, as well as set up strangulation traps and rapid reinforcement channels. If the Beyond Grade As fall too deep, there's a chance that they will be surrounded and annihilated by us …"

"Give me a report later." Ewen raised his hand, indicating that there was no need to say more. He then turned to ask about the progress of the other arrangements.

Whether or not the three Universal Civilizations and the association would fight in the end was not his concern. He only cared about his duty, which was to prepare for the war and ensure that the strategic plan could be carried out strictly.

…

On Planet Lighthouse Planet Lighthouse devices were floating floating floating floating devices

From the outside, it looked like a desolate planet, but once they entered the atmosphere, they could see the true appearance of the planet. It was a mechanical fortress armed to the teeth, with countless battleships and mechanical armies moving up and down.

On top of the tallest building, Aurora stood at the edge of the rooftop, looking at a giant white mechanical ring in the distance. This was a new directional teleportation gate technology that Han Xiao had dug out from Jayz's technology treasure trove. It could be used to transport troops on a large scale, but it had not been activated yet.

Behind her stood a dense crowd, their bodies emitting a faint glow. They were all reincarnated Hero Spirits who had obtained physical bodies.

The eight Hero Spirit Kings were lined up in a row, followed by thousands of Calamity Grade Hero Spirits, followed by countless Grade B Hero Spirits.

When Manison's warehouse was destroyed, Han Xiao had urgently summoned Aurora, who was wandering outside, and given her a secret mission, which was to hide in a secret base and use Edo Reincarnation non-stop. Other than eating, drinking, and resting, she would spend the rest of her time summoning the Underworld Hero Spirits.

Aurora's life during this period was to summon Hero Spirits, rest, and recover, then continue summoning. This cycle almost drained her dry, and it was not easy for her to reach her current scale.

The duration of these reincarnated Hero Spirits was dependent on the speed of their body's activity loss. As long as they were not killed or removed by Aurora, they could basically exist for a long time. Especially now that they were in low-energy standby mode without fighting, the speed of their activity loss was almost negligible. This was why Aurora could continue to expand her scale and accumulate an army.

Aurora turned to look at the Hero Spirits and said softly, "Black Star said that before the warning period ends, you guys are to cause a ruckus in the Dawn Star Cluster and destroy the three Universal Civilizations' Planetary Obliteration weapons as much as possible."

"He sure knows how to order people around."

Sorokin snorted.

After being a Hero Spirit for more than forty years, he had already accepted his fate and gotten used to his identity. However, he still did not give up his hobby of accumulating wealth. In order to satisfy his hobby, he thought of a way to modify the social environment of the Underworld.

Because Hero Spirits basically did not have any material enjoyment in their soul form, Sorokin discovered the common needs of many Hero Spirits after a long period of observation. Therefore, according to the characteristics of the Hero Spirits, he created a concept currency system in the Underworld based on 'promises'. A Promise Currency meant that he owed someone something, and different levels and identities of heroic spirits gave different "face values" for their promises.

When a Hero Spirit made a promise to another or more Hero Spirits, it was equivalent to printing money. Sorokin came up with a special credit system to prevent the Hero Spirits from recklessly making promises that would cause inflation and solve a series of problems that would damage the value of the promise currency. Furthermore, the amount of promise currency that each Hero Spirit could create per cycle was limited, and this two-way promise currency could be sold to others. It was similar to transferring a 'debt relationship'.

In order to implement this system, Sorokin had put in a lot of effort. He even convinced Aurora and Onicelu to link the cashing method with the chance of reincarnation and the time of reincarnation. This was equivalent to a chance for ordinary Hero Spirits to get some fresh air. The Hero Spirits of the Underworld who had nothing to do usually slowly accepted this system.

After cultivating a market, Sorokin used a series of skillful capitalist methods to harvest a large amount of promise currency. Now, the average Hero Spirit of the Underworld owed him 0.37 requests, and he had become the 'richest' person in the Underworld. Although it did not have much practical significance, the wealth itself satisfied him.

This war allowed Sorokin to see the opportunity to realize the promise currency on a large scale. After all, the Hero Spirits of the Underworld were natural death squads, so they would definitely be reincarnated frequently. Although they were summoned to fight, it was much better than staying in the Underworld and doing nothing.

As for the conflict between the association and the three Universal Civilizations, Sorokin was not interested. After all, his identity was different now, and it was not his place to worry about such things.

Aurora retracted her gaze and continued to look ahead. In a place where the Hero Spirits could not see, her expression became worried.

In a few key Star Fields, the three Universal Civilizations and the association had similar spies. Once a full-scale war broke out, there would be a storm of blood everywhere. She could not bear to see such a scene.

"If the war really breaks out, I hope I can save more people with the Underworld …"

…

Primeval Star River, Mechanical Race territory …

The news media was still broadcasting the confrontation. It had been a long time since the negotiation failed, and Han Xiao was in the middle. It was as if he was separating the two fleets, and no one moved.

Looking at the broadcast that seemed to be frozen, the countless galactic residents became more and more anxious.

More than half a day had passed, and there was still no movement from either side. Were they going to be in a stalemate for the next ten days? Ten days later, there would not be any change in the attitude of either side, right?

Just as many people were feeling pessimistic, there was a sudden movement in the three Universal Civilizations' joint fleet. The Multi-Dimensional Sky Opening Transportation Device suddenly activated and spun at high speed for a while. With a flash of light, another small fleet teleported over.

"Reinforcements are here?"

The countless galactic residents were energized. Although they did not know what the three Universal Civilizations were doing, it was good that there were changes.

Through the broadcast, the gazes of countless people followed this small fleet, watching it pass through the military formation and connect with the main ship of the joint fleet.

At the same time, in the command room of the three Universal Civilizations' joint fleet, all the crew members, including Commander Simon, stood up to welcome the newcomers.

The sound of footsteps slowly approached along the corridor, and a group of people with different appearances walked into the command room.

Seeing this, the crew members were slightly restless. They deliberately lowered their voices and excitedly chatted, reporting the names of this group of people.

"'Dark Emperor' Clottey of the Red Empire, 'Thunder' Guzar, 'Leader' Padro, 'Army Flag' Enid … 'Golden Ring' Oulou of the Radiant Federation, 'Super Teacher' Verena, 'Guardian' Rama … 'God's Chosen' Wuornos of the Arcane Church, 'Mechanical Catastrophe' Francisco, 'Saint' Moran … They're all big shots!"

At this time, all the direct Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations had arrived. There were dozens of them who had been urgently recruited.

Simon took a few steps forward, nodded to everyone, and said, "Everyone, let's not waste time. I believe the upper echelons have already given the order. Everyone knows what to do."

Hearing this, everyone turned to look out of the porthole, their eyes locked onto Han Xiao, who was occupying the starry sky.

Oulou smirked, revealing a sinister look.

"Don't worry. Since we're here, he won't be able to continue showing off."

"I'll leave Black Star to you guys." Simon nodded.

The exchange of fire between the fleets was the signal for an all-out war. Before the deadline, the three Universal Civilizations did not allow their armies to take action. However, since Black Star had jumped out to challenge them in his own name, they could use their upper echelons to test the waters. Therefore, the three Universal Civilizations called their direct members, not willing to see Black Star continue to be arrogant. They planned to reduce the prestige of the association and put pressure on him.

At this time, Verena, with her long hair fluttering in the wind, glanced at everyone and slowly said,

"Black Star is famous for his ferocity and his battle record. He's extremely difficult to deal with. However, if we gang up on him from the start, it won't look good. Only Clottey, Oulou, and Wuornos have the ability to fight Black Star alone. Which of you three will go first?"

Hearing this, everyone's eyes turned to the three of them. Most of them looked at Wuornos, who was recognized as the strongest.

Wuornos lowered his eyes and remained silent, as if he was not interested in this mission.

In fact, if not for the Ethereal Pope ordering him to come here, he would not have wanted to leave the Pantheon Temple at all.

Seeing that he did not speak, everyone looked away and looked at Clottey.

"You used to work with Black Star, so you should know his abilities better than us," Verena said.

Clottey frowned. "I don't know more than you guys. He …"

At this time, Oulou interrupted him.

"Stop fighting. I'll deal with him. I've long wanted to fight Black Star. Maybe I can take him down directly."

Seeing this, everyone nodded. No one fought with him.

At this moment, Verena tapped her forehead with her finger, and a pure white spiritual light flew out and landed on Oulou's body.

Oulou shuddered and felt the energy in his body start to surge and roar. His strength increased bit by bit.

"Heh, even without strengthening, I can deal with Black Star."

Oulou clicked his tongue and did not appreciate it.

"This is all for safety reasons."

Verena's expression did not change.

She was the director of the Radiant Federation's Superpower Research Institute. She had a compound Esper Ability, which was mainly inclined to support and strengthen the abilities of other Supers. She could also analyze the development trend of the target's abilities and formulate a perfect training plan. This was also the origin of her nickname 'Super Mentor'.

…

A few minutes later …

Han Xiao, who was resting in the middle of the battlefield, suddenly frowned and slowly opened his eyes.

In his vision, a familiar figure walked out of the three Universal Civilizations' fleet formation and floated not far away from him, exuding a powerful aura that belonged to a peak Beyond Grade A.

"Oulou?"

Han Xiao spoke softly, and his voice sounded in the public channel.

Oulou narrowed his eyes.

"I heard that if I want the association to hand over the technology, I have to go through you first?"

"As long as you can beat me, it's not impossible."

Han Xiao did not think much of it and replied casually.

Hearing this, Oulou's eyes flashed, and he said with a deep voice.

"Then you can start thinking about it now!"

Then, his aura quickly rose, and dense golden rings spread out behind him, connecting to a dazzling golden world. The energy seemed to be endless. This was the 'Golden Treasure Ship' dimension that made him famous.

Seeing this, Han Xiao shook his head and slowly said.

"Do you want to consider joining the association to enjoy the Sanctum Revival? That way, you won't die for nothing later. "
